# Weaver Android: AG1 permission allowlist (K-79 detailed design 5.8.1).
# One entry per line: <class> <permission> [maxSdk=<n>]
#   A = allowed (declared by the app; must match the source manifest exactly)
#   B = allowed, added by libraries at manifest merge time (measured; see the pending line below)
#   C = forbidden
# {APPLICATION_ID} is replaced with --application-id. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The number of A entries is not fixed in the guard; this file is the source of truth.
#
# --- A: kept as upstream (same as the iOS usage-description policy) ---
A android.permission.INTERNET
A android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
A android.permission.CAMERA
A android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
A android.permission.VIBRATE
A android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
A android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
A android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
A android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdk=32
A android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdk=32
A android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
A android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
A android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
A android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
A android.permission.BLUETOOTH maxSdk=30
A android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN maxSdk=30
A android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
A android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
#
# --- B: library permissions at merge time. Not fixed yet; the measurement run fixes them (stage S3) ---
B-PENDING
#
# --- C: forbidden ---
C android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
C android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
